license_required.quote: A person who is an individual may not engage in the practice of public accountancy unless the person holds a certificate issued under this chapter or practices in this state under a privilege under Section 901.462.

issuing_authority.value: Texas State Board of Public Accountancy
issuing_authority.quote: "Board" means the Texas State Board of Public Accountancy.

name.value: Texas State Board of Public Accountancy
name.quote: "Board" means the Texas State Board of Public Accountancy.

type.quote: The board shall: (1) administer this chapter; (2) adopt rules the board determines are necessary or advisable to administer this chapter

moral_character_required.quote: The board shall ensure that an applicant to take the uniform CPA examination or to receive a certificate lacks a history of dishonest or felonious acts.

degree_required.quote: hold a baccalaureate or graduate degree, or its equivalent as determined by board rule, conferred by a board-recognized institution of higher education

required.quote: To be eligible to receive a certificate, a person must complete at least one year of work experience acceptable to the board

duration.quote: complete at least one year of work experience acceptable to the board

kind.value: accounting, attest services, management or financial advisory or consulting services, tax services
kind.quote: experience providing a service or advice involving accounting, attest services, management or financial advisory or consulting services, tax services, or other services the board considers appropriate for an accountant

exams.name: Uniform CPA Examination
exams.notes: The board may use or require the use of all or part of the uniform CPA examination and any related service available from the American Institute of Certified Public Accountants or the National Association of State Boards of Accountancy.
exams.jurisdiction: national (American Institute of Certified Public Accountants or National Association of State Boards of Accountancy)

exams.name: Examination on Rules of Professional Conduct
exams.quote: pass an examination on the rules of professional conduct as determined by board rule

required.quote: A license holder who is an individual shall participate in a program of continuing professional education designed to maintain professional competency.

available.quote: The board shall issue a certificate to a person who holds a certificate or license issued by another state if the person: (1) satisfies at least one of the following...

requirements.value: Applicant must hold certificate from state with comparable education, examination, and experience requirements, or meet requirements for issuance in Texas other than passing the uniform CPA examination, or have four years of experience practicing public accountancy within ten years preceding application, and must have met continuing professional education requirements for three-year period preceding application.
requirements.quote: The board shall issue a certificate to a person who holds a certificate or license issued by another state if the person: (1) satisfies at least one of the following: (A) meets the requirements for issuance of a certificate in this state other than the requirement providing the grades necessary to pass the uniform CPA examination; (B) met the requirements in effect for issuance of a certificate in this state on the date the person was issued a certificate by the other state; or (C) has completed at least four years of experience practicing public accountancy, if the experience: (i) occurred after the person passed the uniform CPA examination and within the 10 years preceding the date of application; and (ii) satisfies requirements established by board rule; and (2) has met the continuing professional education requirements that apply to a license holder under this chapter for the three-year period preceding the date of application.

exists.quote: The board shall: (1) administer this chapter; (2) adopt rules the board determines are necessary or advisable to administer this chapter

national_certification.value: American Institute of Certified Public Accountants (AICPA)
national_certification.quote: the uniform CPA examination and any related service available from: (1) the American Institute of Certified Public Accountants; or (2) the National Association of State Boards of Accountancy

national_association.value: American Institute of Certified Public Accountants (AICPA)
national_association.quote: standards adopted by the American Institute of Certified Public Accountants or another national accountancy organization recognized by the board

regulatory_model.quote: A person who is an individual may not engage in the practice of public accountancy unless the person holds a certificate issued under this chapter

credential_type.quote: The board shall issue a certificate to a person who meets the applicable requirements of this chapter.

is_mandatory.quote: A person who is an individual may not engage in the practice of public accountancy unless the person holds a certificate issued under this chapter or practices in this state under a privilege under Section 901.462.

title_protection.quote: A person may not assume or use the title or designation "certified public accountant," the abbreviation "CPA," or any other title, designation, word, letter, abbreviation, sign, card, or device tending to indicate that the person is a certified public accountant unless the person holds a certificate under this chapter.

scope_protection.quote: A person who is an individual may not engage in the practice of public accountancy unless the person holds a certificate issued under this chapter or practices in this state under a privilege under Section 901.462.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud or deceit in obtaining a certificate, firm license, or license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: fraud or deceit in obtaining a certificate, firm license, or license under this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud, dishonesty, or gross negligence in the performance of services
disciplinary_grounds.quote: fraud, dishonesty, or gross negligence in the performance of services as a license holder, including: (A) knowingly participating in the preparation of a false or misleading financial statement or tax return; or (B) failing to file the license holder's own income tax return

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to obtain a license within required timeframe
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the failure of a person who is certified or required to hold a firm license under this chapter to obtain a license not later than the third anniversary of the date on which the person was certified or required to obtain a firm license

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to renew license within required timeframe
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the failure of a person who is licensed under this chapter to renew the license not later than the third anniversary of the date on which the person most recently obtained or renewed the license

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of Subchapter J (professional conduct rules)
Violation of rules of professional conduct adopted by the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: a violation of a rule of professional conduct adopted by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Revocation or suspension of certificate or license of partner, member, or shareholder
disciplinary_grounds.quote: a revocation or suspension of the certificate or firm license or a revocation, suspension, or refusal to renew the license of the person's partner, member, or shareholder

disciplinary_grounds.description: Revocation, suspension, or refusal to renew by another state
disciplinary_grounds.quote: a revocation, cancellation, placement on probation, limitation on the scope of practice, or suspension by another state, or a refusal of renewal by another state, of the authority issued by that state to the person, or to the person's partner, member, or shareholder, to engage in the practice of public accountancy for a reason other than the failure to pay the appropriate authorization fee

disciplinary_grounds.description: Revocation or suspension of right to practice before state or federal agency
disciplinary_grounds.quote: a revocation or suspension of, or a voluntary consent decree concerning, the right of the person, or of the person's partner, member, or shareholder, to practice before a state or federal agency for a reason the board determines warrants its action

disciplinary_grounds.description: Final conviction of felony or offense involving fraud or dishonesty
disciplinary_grounds.quote: a final conviction of or the imposition of deferred adjudication for an offense under the laws of any state or the United States that: (A) is a felony; or (B) includes fraud or dishonesty as an element of the offense

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conduct indicating lack of fitness to serve the public as a professional accountant
disciplinary_grounds.quote: conduct indicating lack of fitness to serve the public as a professional accountant

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of chapter, professional standards, or board rules by license holder or non-licensee owner
disciplinary_grounds.quote: a violation by a license holder or an owner of a certified public accountancy firm who is not a license holder of: (A) this chapter; (B) professional standards adopted by the board; or (C) a rule or order adopted by the board

definition_quote.value: the performance for a client by a person who is certified, licensed, or registered under this chapter of a service that involves the use of accounting, attesting, or auditing skills; the performance or offer of performance for a client or potential client by a person who represents to the public that the person is certified, licensed, or registered under this chapter of a service that involves the use of accounting, attesting, or auditing skills; the performance of activities of a person or practice unit licensed under this chapter in preparing or reporting on a financial statement or report that is to be used by an investor, the management of an organization, a third party, or a financial institution, unless the report is prepared for internal use only; or preparing a tax return that is filed with a taxing authority; or the supervision of an activity described by Subdivision (3).
definition_quote.quote: "practice of public accountancy" means: (1) the performance for a client by a person who is certified, licensed, or registered under this chapter of a service that involves the use of accounting, attesting, or auditing skills; (2) the performance or offer of performance for a client or potential client by a person who represents to the public that the person is certified, licensed, or registered under this chapter of a service that involves the use of accounting, attesting, or auditing skills; (3) the performance of activities of a person or practice unit licensed under this chapter in: (A) preparing or reporting on a financial statement or report that is to be used by an investor, the management of an organization, a third party, or a financial institution, unless the report is prepared for internal use only; or (B) preparing a tax return that is filed with a taxing authority; or (4) the supervision of an activity described by Subdivision (3).

value: providing management or financial advisory or consulting services
methods_authorized.quote: a service that involves the use of accounting, attesting, or auditing skills includes: (1) issuing a report on or preparing a financial statement; (2) providing management or financial advisory or consulting services; and (3) preparing a tax return or advising or consulting on a tax matter.

value: audit or other engagement in accordance with auditing standards
engagement in accordance with standards for accounting and review services
engagement in accordance with standards for attestation engagements
any other assurance service in accordance with professional standards
attest_services_types.quote: "Attest service" means: (A) an audit or other engagement required by the board to be performed in accordance with the auditing standards adopted by the American Institute of Certified Public Accountants or another national accountancy organization recognized by the board; (B) an engagement required by the board to be performed in accordance with standards for accounting and review services adopted by the American Institute of Certified Public Accountants or another national accountancy organization recognized by the board; (C) an engagement required by the board to be performed in accordance with standards for attestation engagements adopted by the American Institute of Certified Public Accountants or another national accountancy organization recognized by the board; or (D) any other assurance service required by the board to be performed in accordance with professional standards adopted by the American Institute of Certified Public Accountants or another national accountancy organization recognized by the board.

compilation_services_authorized.quote: A person who is not a license holder and who does not practice under a privilege under Section 901.461 or 901.462: (1) may not use language in any statement related to the financial affairs of a person that is conventionally used by license holders in reports on financial statements; (2) may prepare financial statements; and (3) may issue nonattest transmittals or information regarding nonattest transmittals if the transmittals or information do not purport to be in compliance with standards for accounting and review services

education_semester_hours_required.quote: complete at least 150 semester hours or quarter-hour equivalents in board-recognized courses, including an accounting concentration or equivalent courses that meet the education requirements established under Section 901.254

exam_sit_hours_minimum.quote: complete at least 120 semester hours or quarter-hour equivalents in board-recognized courses, including at least 24 semester hours of accounting or equivalent courses as determined by board rule

ethics_exam_required.quote: pass an examination on the rules of professional conduct as determined by board rule

practice_privilege_no_notice_required.quote: An individual who meets the requirements of Subsection (a)(1) or (2) and who offers or renders professional services in person or by mail, telephone, or electronic means may practice public accountancy in this state without notice to the board.

value: subject to personal and subject matter jurisdiction and disciplinary authority of the board
must comply with this chapter and the board's rules
appointed the regulatory agency of the state that issued the individual's certificate or license as the agent on whom process may be served
practice_privilege_consent_conditions.quote: An individual practicing under the privilege under this section, as a condition of the privilege of practicing without a certificate or license: (1) is subject to the personal and subject matter jurisdiction and disciplinary authority of the board; (2) must comply with this chapter and the board's rules; and (3) is considered to have appointed the regulatory agency of the state that issued the individual's certificate or license as the agent on whom process may be served in any action or proceeding by the board against the individual.

attest_services_require_firm_permit.quote: A firm may not provide attest services or use the title "CPA's," "CPA Firm," "Certified Public Accountants," "Certified Public Accounting Firm," or "Auditing Firm" or a variation of one of those titles unless the firm holds a firm license issued under this subchapter or practices in this state under a privilege under Section 901.461.

firm_majority_cpa_ownership_required.quote: An applicant for initial issuance or renewal of a firm license must show that a majority of the ownership of the firm, in terms of financial interests and voting rights, belongs to persons who hold certificates issued under this chapter or are licensed in another state.

nonlicensee_firm_owners_permitted.quote: A certified public accountancy firm may include individuals as owners who are not license holders if: (1) the firm designates to the board as responsible for the firm's license a license holder who resides in this state; (2) each owner who is not a license holder and who is a resident of this state as determined by board rule: (A) is actively involved in the firm or an affiliated entity; (B) lacks a history of dishonest or felonious acts; (C) maintains any professional designation held by the individual in good standing with the appropriate organization or regulatory body that is identified or used in an advertisement, letterhead, business card, or other firm-related communication; (D) has passed an examination on the rules of professional conduct as determined by board rule; and (E) complies with the rules of professional conduct as determined by board rule

peer_review_required_for_firm_renewal.quote: The board by rule shall provide for a peer review program to review the work product of a license holder or of the certified public accountancy firm in which the license holder is a member, in lieu of the license holder, to the extent necessary to comply with any applicable standards adopted by generally recognized bodies responsible for setting accounting standards.

inactive_license_status_available.quote: The board by rule may establish a reduced fee to issue or renew the license of a person who does not engage in the practice of public accountancy because of retirement or permanent disability.

retired_license_status_available.quote: The board by rule may establish a reduced fee to issue or renew the license of a person who does not engage in the practice of public accountancy because of retirement or permanent disability.

out_of_state_firm_no_office_exemption.quote: A certified public accountancy firm that is not licensed in this state but is licensed in another state may practice in this state without a firm license or notice to the board if the firm's practice in this state is performed by an individual who holds a license under this chapter or who practices under a privilege under Section 901.462.

office_supervision_by_licensed_cpa_requi.quote: An applicant for issuance or renewal of a firm license under this section must register each office of the firm in this state and show that all attest services performed in this state are under the supervision of a person who holds a certificate issued under this chapter or by another state.

attest_report_signer_competency_requirem.quote: An individual who is a license holder or practices under a privilege under Section 901.462 and who is responsible for supervising attest services or signs or authorizes another person to sign an accountant's reports on financial statements on behalf of a certified public accountancy firm must meet the competency requirements of the professional standards that apply to those services.

client_confidentiality_privilege.quote: A license holder or a partner, member, officer, shareholder, or employee of a license holder may not voluntarily disclose information communicated to the license holder or a partner, member, shareholder, or employee of the license holder by a client in connection with services provided to the client by the license holder or a partner, member, shareholder, or employee of the license holder, except with the permission of the client or the client's representative.

safe_harbor_disclaimer_language_for_nonl.quote: The following safe harbor language may be used by a person who is not a license holder without violating Subsection (b): "(I/We) have prepared the accompanying balance sheet of (client's name) as of (date) and the related statements of income, retained earnings, and cash flow changes in financial position for the (period then ended). These financial statements, which are the representation of management and which are presented to be used for federal income tax purposes, (are/are not) in agreement with the company's financial records. Management has elected to omit substantially all informative disclosures with respect to these financial statements. If the omitted disclosures were included in the above financial statements, they might influence the user's conclusion concerning the company's financial position, results of operations, and/or changes in financial position. (I/We) do not express any form of assurance with respect to these financial statements."

foreign_accountant_practice_exception.quote: A person who holds a certification, degree, license, or other credential granted in a foreign jurisdiction that entitles the person to engage in the practice of public accountancy or its equivalent in that jurisdiction may use in this state any title or designation under which the person practices in the foreign jurisdiction, followed by a translation of the title or designation into English if it is in a different language and by the name of that jurisdiction, if: (1) the person's activities in this state are limited to the provision of professional accounting services to persons who are residents, governments, or business entities of that foreign jurisdiction; and (2) the person does not perform attest services or issue reports on the financial statements of any other person in this state.

single_act_evidence_sufficient.quote: In an action brought under this chapter, evidence of a single act prohibited by this chapter is sufficient to justify a penalty, injunction, restraining order, or conviction without evidence of a general course of conduct.

firm_corrective_action_period_for_owners.quote: A certified public accountancy firm that is no longer in compliance with this section because of a change in firm ownership or personnel that occurs after the firm receives or renews a firm license shall report that fact to the board not later than the 30th day after the date the firm ceases to be in compliance and shall take corrective action to bring the firm into compliance. Failure to bring the firm into compliance within a reasonable time as determined by board rule is grounds for the suspension or revocation of the firm's firm license.

firm_permit_required_for_attest_services.quote: A firm may not provide attest services or use the title "CPA's," "CPA Firm," "Certified Public Accountants," "Certified Public Accounting Firm," or "Auditing Firm" or a variation of one of those titles unless the firm holds a firm license issued under this subchapter or practices in this state under a privilege under Section 901.461.

cpa_emeritus_or_retired_status_available.quote: The board by rule may establish a reduced fee to issue or renew the license of a person who does not engage in the practice of public accountancy because of retirement or permanent disability.
